title: Tailoring the structural durability and proton conductivity of electrolytes for highly fuel-flexible and reversible ceramic cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6701-6713
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01318F, Paper
Fan He, Yixuan Huang, Kang Xu, Yangsen Xu, Feng Zhu, Shihang Guo, Donglin Han, Haoliang Tao, Liangzhu Zhu, Kotaro Sasaki, YongMan Choi, Zongping Shao, Yu Chen
We report an electrolyte material BaZr0.06Ce0.7Y0.06Yb0.06Hf0.06Gd0.06O3−δ (BZCYYbHG), which demonstrates excellent durability against coking, CO2, and H2O under fuel-cell and electrolysis operations with high fuel flexibility and reversibility.
